speaker: Unknown
en: AI is becoming more powerful, but the resources needed to build it are increasingly concentrated.
zh: AI 正变得越来越强大，但构建它所需的资源正日益集中。

speaker: Unknown
en: Does it have to stay that way?
zh: 事情一定要这样继续下去吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: MTS host Sophia Du heads to the Open Source AI Summit in San Francisco to ask researchers and founders across the AI stack whether open source can create a more distributed future for AI.
zh: MTS 主持人 Sophia Du 前往旧金山的开源 AI 峰会，询问横跨 AI 技术栈的研究者和创始人们，开源能否为 AI 创造一个更加分布式的未来。

speaker: Unknown
en: Lucas Kaiser, co-author of the landmark Attention is All You Need paper, argues that today's concentration may be a property of our current technology, not an inevitable feature of AI.
zh: 具有里程碑意义的《Attention is All You Need》论文的共同作者 Lucas Kaiser 认为，今天的集中化可能是我们当前技术的一种属性，而不是 AI 不可避免的特征。

speaker: Unknown
en: Transformers thrive on enormous amounts of data and compute, but they're less than a decade old, and the next breakthrough could change those economics.
zh: Transformer 依赖海量的数据和算力才能兴旺，但它们问世还不到十年，下一个突破可能会改变这些经济学。

speaker: Unknown
en: From open models and access to compute, to companies owning their own intelligence, Sophia explores where AI power is actually concentrating, what openness can change, and what it still leaves unsolved.
zh: 从开放模型和算力获取，到公司拥有自己的智能，Sophia 探讨了 AI 权力究竟集中在哪里，开放性能改变什么，以及它还有什么没有解决。

speaker: Unknown
en: Joining me is Lucas Kaiser, an AI researcher and the co-author of Attention is All You Need, the paper that introduced the transformer that completely changed modern day AI.
zh: 今天和我一起的是 Lucas Kaiser，一位 AI 研究者，也是《Attention is All You Need》的共同作者，这篇论文引入了彻底改变现代 AI 的 transformer。

speaker: Unknown
en: Where is modern day AI and where is power currently concentrating?
zh: 现代 AI 处于什么状态？权力目前集中在哪里？

speaker: Unknown
en: There was a very important moment sometime around end of last year, start of this year, where the coding agents started to work.
zh: 大约在去年年底、今年年初的某个时候，有一个非常重要的时刻，编码智能体开始能用了。

speaker: Unknown
en: The nature of this AI is that you need to train it on very expensive data centers and on a lot of data.
zh: 这种 AI 的本质是，你需要在非常昂贵的数据中心上、用大量数据来训练它。

speaker: Unknown
en: So there's big companies that do this and then they charge for it, right?
zh: 所以有大公司来做这件事，然后他们收费，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: That concentrates it in the sense to get the, like, to me, even the current models are not smart enough.
zh: 这就造成了集中，意思是，要得到那个，比如，对我来说，即便是现在的模型也不够聪明。

speaker: Unknown
en: So there still could be much smarter, right?
zh: 所以它们还能变得更聪明得多，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: There may be some research breakthroughs that are needed to make them smarter with less data, but since research breakthroughs...
zh: 可能需要一些研究上的突破，才能让它们用更少的数据变得更聪明，但既然是研究突破……

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, sometimes they come, sometimes they don't.
zh: 你知道的，有时候会来，有时候不会。

speaker: Unknown
en: They're not like a business proposition.
zh: 它们不像一个商业提案。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the big companies are like, okay, but you can do things without research breakthrough, which is to go bigger, bigger, bigger.
zh: 但大公司会说，好吧，你可以在没有研究突破的情况下做事，那就是做得更大、更大、再更大。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now that is very concentrated.
zh: 而这就是非常集中的。

speaker: Unknown
en: You go bigger, bigger, you need billions of dollars.
zh: 你要做得更大更大，你就需要几十亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to scrape data from every corner of the internet.
zh: 你需要从互联网的每个角落抓取数据。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the current state of the technology is a bit concentrating, but we should remember that it's just the current state.
zh: 所以当前技术的状态是有点趋向集中的，但我们应该记住，这只是当前的状态。

speaker: Unknown
en: Sure, transformers are great, but they're not even 10 years old.
zh: 当然，transformer 很棒，但它们甚至还不满 10 岁。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm sure will be other things.
zh: 我确信会有其他东西出现。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe we'll make it possible to train with less data, more diverse models.
zh: 也许我们会做到用更少的数据训练、更多样化的模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like transformers are really good if you train them on the whole internet and then they're reasonably smart.
zh: 比如，transformer 如果你在整个互联网上训练它们，它们就相当聪明。

speaker: Unknown
en: But if you try to say, you know, you just learn about this.
zh: 但如果你试着说，你知道，你只学这个。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then they're just stupid, right?
zh: 那它们就很蠢，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It doesn't work that well.
zh: 效果就没那么好。

speaker: Unknown
en: But it doesn't work because maybe we need a research breakthrough that will make it work.
zh: 但效果不好可能是因为我们需要一个研究突破来让它可行。

speaker: Unknown
en: But the transformer needs to be everything.
zh: 但 transformer 必须是一切。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's a problem, but it's a research problem that hopefully will get solved.
zh: 这是个问题，但这是一个有望被解决的研究问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: With the transformer, architecturally, you need a lot of resources.
zh: 就 transformer 而言，在架构上，你需要大量资源。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the more resources you have as a company, as a model, the more powerful you can be.
zh: 而你作为一家公司、作为一个模型，拥有的资源越多，你就可能越强大。

speaker: Unknown
en: But do you think there is a type of algorithmic breakthrough or some type of research breakthrough that will allow smaller players to really compete?
zh: 但你认为是否会有某种算法突破或某种研究突破，让更小的玩家能够真正竞争？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I mean, we know it exists.
zh: 嗯，我是说，我们知道它存在。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are the proof, right?
zh: 我们就是证明，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Humans are not experts in everything.
zh: 人类并不是样样精通的专家。

speaker: Unknown
en: But in the field, there are experts that are very good, sometimes better than our super huge models.
zh: 但在特定领域，有非常擅长的专家，有时比我们超级巨大的模型还好。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it exists.
zh: 所以它是存在的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't think we have found it technically.
zh: 我不认为我们在技术上已经找到了它。

speaker: Unknown
en: It may even have attention layers somewhere, right?
zh: 它甚至可能在某处有注意力层，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: It may be because it's not just the model.
zh: 可能是因为它不仅仅是模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's also the loss and the data and how it's trained.
zh: 还有损失函数、数据以及它的训练方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: There's a lot of factors, so we don't really know exactly where to look.
zh: 有很多因素，所以我们并不真正确切知道该往哪里找。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the thing in research.
zh: 这就是研究中的情况。

speaker: Unknown
en: But on the other hand, I think more and more people are looking, I hope.
zh: 但另一方面，我认为越来越多的人在寻找，我希望如此。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think the labs have a little bit, you know, OpenAI, when I joined, was a very research lab.
zh: 我认为实验室有一点，你知道，我加入时，OpenAI 是一个非常纯粹的研究实验室。

speaker: Unknown
en: Now it's a research lab a bit, but it's also a very big company that needs to do products and stuff.
zh: 现在它有点算是研究实验室，但它也是一家非常大的公司，需要做产品和各种东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it has less focus on researching.
zh: 所以它对研究的专注变少了。

speaker: Unknown
en: But this gives the chance to the open source movement, that's a chance for academia to universities.
zh: 但这给了开源运动机会，也是学术界和大学的机会。

speaker: Unknown
en: I recently started doing things on my own also, and it's funny, so I bought a 5090 RTX GPU.
zh: 我最近也开始自己做一些事情，很有意思，我买了一块 5090 RTX GPU。

speaker: Unknown
en: It has more power than the eight 8GPU machines we used as a team to do the Transformers research.
zh: 它比我们团队当年做 Transformers 研究时用的八台 8GPU 机器算力还强。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can buy and have one GPU that has all the power we used to design Transformer.
zh: 所以你可以买一块 GPU,它就拥有我们当年设计 Transformer 时用的全部算力。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, you know, so you can do things with it.
zh: 所以，你知道，你可以用它来做事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like you can't train a big LLM, but you can research and experiment on things.
zh: 比如你没法训练一个大的 LLM,但你可以做研究和实验。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think many people should.
zh: 而且我认为很多人应该这么做。

speaker: Unknown
en: I believe there is still much more in machine learning research then.
zh: 我相信机器学习研究还有非常多的东西可挖掘。

speaker: Unknown
en: My last question for you is, what makes you feel optimistic that the future of AI is going in a direction that will be truly open and broadly empowering for everyone?
zh: 我最后一个问题是，是什么让你对 AI 的未来感到乐观，认为它正朝着真正开放、让所有人都能受益的方向前进？

speaker: Unknown
en: If you look at the world, humans are the most amazing computers in the world, right?
zh: 如果你看看这个世界，人类是世界上最令人惊叹的计算机，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Our brains are still unmatched by the models, and we are not generalists, and there's not like one big brain of humanity.
zh: 我们的大脑仍然不输给模型，我们也不是通才，而且不存在一个全人类的大脑。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think fundamentally, it might be that given a fixed amount of data, the best way to learn from it is to have a lot of distributed models.
zh: 我从根本上认为，在给定固定数据量的情况下，从数据中学习的最佳方式可能是拥有大量分布式的模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: Strong on its own, but even stronger.
zh: 各自强大，但合在一起更强。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if you look at some basic research, there are actually reasons to believe it.
zh: 如果你看看一些基础研究，其实有理由相信这一点。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like I was just talking about ensembles and things like that.
zh: 比如我刚才提到的集成(ensemble)之类的东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: So yes, transformers are great when you feed them all of the internet, but we know there is an algorithm that's even better and it can learn from much smaller data and be amazing at the things it's learning.
zh: 所以是的，Transformer 在你喂给它整个互联网时很强大，但我们知道存在一个更优秀的算法，它能从小得多的数据中学习，并在所学的东西上表现得令人惊叹。

speaker: Unknown
en: We are the proof.
zh: 我们就是证明。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have not found it yet.
zh: 我们还没有找到它。

speaker: Unknown
en: How to do this in computers very well.
zh: 也就是如何在计算机上把这件事做得很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: But we will.
zh: 但我们会找到的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, progress in machine learning has not stopped in 2017.
zh: 我是说，机器学习的进步并没有止步于 2017 年。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, because it's so good, everyone has focused on the big data.
zh: 当然，因为它太好用，大家都聚焦在大数据上。

speaker: Unknown
en: But now that it's so expensive, maybe we will focus back more on more fundamental research.
zh: 但现在既然这么昂贵，也许我们会重新更多聚焦于更基础的研究。

speaker: Unknown
en: And yeah, I'm absolutely convinced it can work and it just needs research and effort.
zh: 所以，是的，我绝对相信它能行，它只是需要研究和努力。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think many people sometimes look at the current state of AI and get a little pessimistic, that it's like, you know, it's just big companies, big data centers, everything's so big, and then you get a subscription to something you cannot do much about.
zh: 我想有时候很多人看到 AI 的现状会感到有点悲观，觉得，你知道，就是大公司、大数据中心，一切都如此庞大，然后你订阅一个服务，却做不了什么大事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And to me, it's like, okay, but that's just the current state, you know, it's just this year, next year.
zh: 而对我来说，我觉得，好吧，但这只是当前的状态，你知道，只是今年、明年。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a step in the technology, but it's a step towards something much more fun where everyone can have their own model maybe.
zh: 这是技术的一个阶段，但它是朝着更有意思的东西迈进的一步，也许每个人都能拥有自己的模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: We'll learn from much smaller data.
zh: 它们会从小得多的数据中学习。

speaker: Unknown
en: The models will be experts in different domains like we are and maybe one will be making jokes this way and another another way.
zh: 模型会像我们一样成为不同领域的专家，也许一个擅长这样讲笑话，另一个那样讲。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like currently when you ask a big language model about a joke, it's always the same, something about atoms.
zh: 就像现在你问一个大的语言模型要个笑话，答案总是一样的，总是关于原子的什么梗。

speaker: Unknown
en: This will change because it's an outcome of a technology and the technology will change when the research catches up.
zh: 这会改变的，因为这是技术的产物，而当研究追上来时，技术就会改变。

speaker: Unknown
en: And also for researchers, there's just a huge opportunity to catch up with this.
zh: 而且对研究者来说，追赶这个方向是一个巨大的机会。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, you know, just don't worry about, okay, it got concentrated because that was a convenient thing to do.
zh: 所以，你知道，不用担心，好吧，它变得集中了，因为那是当时最方便的做法。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it showed that great things can be done.
zh: 而它证明了伟大的事情是可以做到的。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's good.
zh: 那是好事。

speaker: Unknown
en: But there is a thing ahead that we just need some research breakthroughs.
zh: 但前面还有一件事，我们只是需要一些研究上的突破。

zh: 感谢收听本期 A16Z 播客。

zh: 再次感谢收听，我们下期节目再见。
